summary: A mother texted her estranged son after three years and he said yes.
realLife: A conservative-leaning Idaho mother lost contact with her liberal son, who stopped speaking to her in 2020. In 2023 she texted to ask if he wanted to talk and he said yes. He later said he needed boundaries with some people. When she asked whether she and her husband were among those he wanted to keep out, he reassured her they were not and that he wanted to keep talking.
gates: A break in contact is on record between parent and child.
Time has passed since the break.
weights: The parent's willingness to ask first.
inGame: A quarrel record and a reconciliation scene fit; needs: a boundary note that limits how much contact there is.

turns.what: He agrees to talk but only about family matters.
He answers months later, after a birth in the family.
